name: launchpad-link-aggregator
author: LaunchPad
description: LaunchPad Agregador de enlaces con interfaz local multiplataforma y sincronización en Firebase

scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && node desktop/scripts/launch-electron.mjs --dev"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:sync && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:linux: npm run desktop:sync && electron-builder --linux --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:win: npm run desktop:sync && electron-builder --win --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run desktop:sync && electron-builder --mac --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
